verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's Marketing API documents a first-party account export: you can generate a new account export or download a finished one. A community user also confirms exporting their subscriber list. The evidence never says which formats the export uses or whether it covers all data, and one user says copying email HTML out of the browser inspector is the only clean way to move templates to another sender. Missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), a list of what the account export covers (templates, reports, automations), and independent hands-on confirmation of a complete migration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
